moments.title: Welsh artist Jamie Miller hits UK No.1
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born singer Jamie Miller has made history, topping the Official UK Singles Chart today with 'Babydoll', becoming the first Welsh solo male artist to do so in 41 years.

angles.name: Local Welsh Pride
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Cardiff's own Jamie Miller! 'Babydoll' is officially the UK Number 1, making him the first Welsh solo male artist to top the charts in over four decades. An incredible moment for Welsh music! #JamieMiller

angles.name: Chart History
angles.copy: History made on the Official Singles Chart! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' takes the top spot, a massive achievement and the first Welsh solo male artist to hit No.1 since 1985. What a track!
